source_sentence: Finally, we combine each of the frame features in X with transcript feature e to get the fused feature C = {c1, · · ·, ct, · · ·, cT |ct = {xt ◦e}} and feed it into a Bi-directional LSTM in order to encode past and future contextual information of video frames: F = Bi-LSTM(C) where F = {f1 · · · fT } ∈ RT×f, and f is the hidden size of the LSTM layers.
